description: This is a test source file for the AssistantLaunch component within an Android application, using Robolectric for unit testing. It contains test cases verifying the parsing of different intent scenarios related to assistant launch.

classes.name: AssistantLaunchTest
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for parsing assistant launch intents within an Android environment, verifying different intent scenarios and their expected parsing outcomes.

methods.name: parsesAssistGestureIntent
methods.description: Test method verifying that an assist gesture intent is correctly parsed, expecting source to be 'assist'.

methods.name: parsesAppActionPrompt
